learning_outcomes.text: Describe common AI governance operating models (centralised, federated, hub-and-spoke) and their trade-offs
Design accountability roles and decision rights for AI across an organisation
Write clear, enforceable AI policies and standards distinct from aspirational principles
Design intake, triage and approval workflows for AI use cases
Define governance metrics and reporting to leadership and the board
Plan the change management needed for governance to be adopted in practice

integrative_case: A retailer scaling from three to forty AI use cases needs a governance operating model: choose the model and decision rights, convert principles into enforceable policy, design intake and approval, and set metrics and change management so it is actually used.
